title: BOOST: Concurrent Access to Host Memory and HBM to Accelerate LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.13592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GPU memory bandwidth and capacity limit throughput in large language model (LLM) inference. The GPU memory system consists of a primary tier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and a secondary tier of host memory connected via CPU-to-GPU interconnect. Current serving systems treat the tiers hierarchically: they serve exclusively from HBM when data fits, and otherwise prefetch data from host memory to HBM before use. In both cases, the host memory bandwidth is never well utilized. Prefetching expands capacity by utilizing host memory, but consumes HBM bandwidth for writes, reducing the bandwidth available for demand loads. We observe that fully utilizing both host and HBM bandwidth requires each wave of GPU threadblocks to access both tiers concurrently and in proportion to their bandwidth ratio. translated_title: BOOST：并发访问主机内存与HBM以加速大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.13592v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：GPU内存带宽和容量限制了大型语言模型（LLM）推理的吞吐量。GPU内存系统由高带宽内存（HBM）作为主层级，以及通过CPU与GPU互连连接的主机内存作为次级层级组成。当前的服务系统以分层方式对待这两个层级：当数据能够容纳时，仅从HBM提供服务；否则，在使用前先将数据从主机内存预取到HBM。在这两种情况下，主机内存带宽都从未得到充分利用。预取通过利用主机内存来扩展容量，但会占用HBM带宽进行写入，从而减少了可用于按需读取的带宽。我们观察到，要充分利用主机内存和HBM两者的带宽，需要每一波GPU线程块同时并发地访问两个层级，并按照两者的带宽比例进行访问。现有的带宽比例放置策略无法提供这种并发性，因为它们不感知GPU波次，并且较大的2MB GPU页……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出BOOST系统，通过使每一波GPU线程块按照带宽比例并发访问主机内存和HBM两个层级，从而同时充分利用两种内存的带宽，以加速LLM推理。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BOOST, which enables each wave of GPU threadblocks to concurrently access host memory and HBM in proportion to their bandwidth ratio, thereby fully utilizing the bandwidth of both memory tiers to accelerate LLM inference.
